largest_risk: A reader may mistake the smooth decaying animation for verified real-world settling behavior; actual dissipation depends on print and surface.
resolution: Existing evidence explicitly labels prescribed damping and no physical test. Carry the same limitation into the manual and public facts; gravity-restoring geometry is supported independently of that animation. The apparent floating is a rendering convention, not a demonstrated geometry defect: reported transformed minimum Z remains zero within numerical tolerance at sampled poses. Teal/gold face colors are software shading, not evidence of multiple materials or parts. Contract packaging adds one solid-rocker build group for the same reviewed rocker; geometry, interaction, images and all Wish constraints are unchanged.
